assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key area polygons are provisional_only (DATA-SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARIES-20260605), sourced from agent_inferred_from_public_data. They are not official redlines, statutory boundaries, or precise area bases.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics (site_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, building_footprint_area_sqm) carry low confidence and must be recalculated when the official polygon is released. Spatial conclusions are limited to intake review, design discussion and iteration; they cannot support formal scoring as statutory figures.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls — road redlines, plot ratios, building heights, setbacks, density, site coverage, plot ownership, municipal utilities, fire safety, flood control and engineering constraints — are not present in the public site package and must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Floor_area_ratio is marked status=unknown; all building height, massing and intensity statements are design recommendations or pending conditions, not statutory controls. The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection zones (文保紫线、建设控制地带) for清华园车站旧址、大钟寺(觉生寺)及京张铁路沿线工业遗产未公开。本轮方案仅给出概念方向，未模拟视廊、高度梯度或文保影响。
assumptions.impact: 大钟寺片区及清华园车站周边的建筑高度、体量、界面和反射材质建议必须在文保影响评估和视廊模拟后复算；当前建议不构成文保审批依据。已在 JZ-04 和大钟寺重点区设计中标注为前置条件。

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR (floor_area_ratio) controls are not present in brief/site-package/ranges/planning_limits.json (status=missing). Total floor area, building height, density and setback cannot be computed as statutory values.
assumptions.impact: metrics.json floor_area_ratio carries status=unknown with confidence=unknown. Any intensity figures in the proposal are conceptual ranges for discussion, not statutory planning conditions.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards describe service concepts only. Operational subjects, input data pipelines, model capability boundaries, human fallback procedures and effectiveness KPIs are pending professional operational design and data-impact assessment.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards in proposal.md and visual/index.html are concept-level; they do not constitute deployed AI systems. Privacy boundary declarations (no personal trajectory collection, no resident profiling for commercial use, campus data requires authorization) are design principles, not implemented governance.

assumptions.statement: Update projects JZ-01 to JZ-06 are concept-level pilot packages. Implementation subject types, project boundaries, decision gates, resource levels, phased outputs, KPIs, O&M responsibility and stop conditions are pending professional project packaging.
assumptions.impact: Project list in proposal.md is a design roadmap, not an implementation commitment. No funding, approval pathway, or construction schedule is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Bilingual artifacts (proposal.en.md, report/proposal.en.html, visual/index.en.html, drawings/*.en.pdf, assets/figures/*.en.png) are required to be substantively equivalent. AI-generated translations and figure labels require human review for terminology consistency per docs/terminology-glossary.md.
assumptions.impact: Bilingual contract v1 requires both language versions to maintain consistent chapters, claims, metrics, evidence citations and figure positions. Mismatched labels or untranslated content in figures may block formal scoring.
